examples.text: „Er zoomte auf das Kinn. Die Qualität verschlechterte sich erheblich, das Bild wurde unscharf, aber er konnte deutlich ein rechteckiges von Narbengewebe umgebenes Hautstück erkennen.“
„Zoomte das Foto auf zweihundert Prozent, sodass sie nur noch einen kleinen Bildausschnitt sah.“
„Eine Größenänderung des Blickfeldes entspricht dem bekannten Zoomen, wobei eine Vergrößerung des Blickfeldes dem Raus-Zoomen und eine Verkleinerung dem Rein-Zoomen entspricht.“

translations.source_sense_description: Fotografie, Optik: einen Bildausschnitt mittels einer Vorrichtung verändern

examples.text: Then, later that day, I logged onto a zoom call and my mother and I set up our yoga mats in the living room, as we had been doing a couple of times a week during the pandemic.

glosses: A humming noise from something moving very fast.
An augmentation of a view, by varying the focal length of a lens, or digitally.

examples.text: What's the zoom like on your camera?

glosses: To move fast with a humming noise.

examples.text: […] and it was strange sitting in their brand-new comfortable car and hearing them talk of exams as we zoomed smoothly into town.

glosses: To change the focal length of a zoom lens.
To manipulate a display so as to magnify or shrink it.

examples.text: to zoom in or zoom out

glosses: To check someone out; to investigate someone that one is interested in.

examples.text: "It boggles my mind what kind of mentality is at work there." He pointed to two recent issues of the magazine that featured cover stories were about Whitney Houston and Luther Vandross, two pop music icons whose sexual orientations have been widely speculated on in Black lesbian and gay communities. "It makes you wonder if it's an insult to the intelligence of Essence’s lesbian and gay leadership," Cunningham said. "Who's really zooming whom here?"
Makowsky was playing the Bassgeige. Zoom... zoom-zoom.... The rest of the orchestra would join in presently.
I would dance a few light fantastic steps to show which way the wind lay, and zoom! Like a breeze I was on the piano stool and doing a velocity exercise.

glosses: Suggesting a sudden change, especially an improvement or an increase
To participate in a video teleconferencing call.
